subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) The woodcutter answered in the negative both the two times and the goddess being satisfied with his honesty, gave him all the three including the real axe. (b) One day while cutting wood beside a river, suddenly his axe slipped out of his hand and fell into deep water. (c) His bitter cry drew the attention of the water-gooddess who took pity on him. (d) Once there lived a poor woodcutter who was very honest. (e) The man was very grieved and began to weep bitterly at the loss of the axe, the only means of his livelihood. (f) Then diving again brought a silver axe and asked the same question if it was his one. (g) Everyday he went to the jungle to cut wood and earned his livelihood by selling the wood in the market. (h) She, diving into the river, brought a golden axe and asked him if it was his one. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d g b e c h f a Once there lived a poor woodcutter who was very honest. Everyday he went to the jungle to cut wood and earned his livelihood by selling the wood in the market. One day while cutting wood beside a river, suddenly his axe slipped out of his hand and fell into deep water. The man was very grieved and began to weep bitterly at the loss of the axe, the only means of his livelihood. His bitter cry drew the attention of the water-gooddess who took pity on him. She, diving into the river, brought a golden axe and asked him if it was his one. Then diving again brought a silver axe and asked the same question if it was his one. The woodcutter answered in the negative both the two times and the goddess being satisfied with his honesty, gave him all the three including the real axe. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 235
